node.title: Spectral root removal and finite projective fibres give an operator3 Johnson bound
node.statement: For a three-dimensional polynomial operator graph with F-eigenspaces of dimension at most one, remove anchor and F-eigenpolynomial roots (common zeros if no F eigenvalue). Maximum remaining projective evaluation fibre H bounds all distinct pair-core intersections. With b_e=a+e(K-a-1), or K-3 when e=0, the positive Johnson gate gives floor((n-b_e)(A-b_e-H)/((A-b_e)^2-(n-b_e)H)) pairs and original raw weight at most n-A times this count. No generic-degree substitution or universal fibre bound is asserted.
